changelog:
Initial release summary: Provides automated project scanning and HTML report generation to detect and help remove "AI flavor" from UI code.

- Scans front-end files (HTML/CSS/JS/Vue/React) for AI-associated colors, emoji icons, and English error message exposures.
- Generates an HTML detection report summarizing issues by category, with tables showing file locations and actionable suggestions.
- Supports triggers like "去掉AI味道", "UI美化", "专业化", and "统一配色".
- Highlights top issues (e.g., purple/neon colors, emoji in UI, English technical errors) and provides prioritized fix recommendations.
- Enables one-click replacement to achieve a more professional, brand-consistent UI style.
summary: 自动扫描项目生成HTML检测报告，检测AI常用色、Emoji图标、英文报错暴露，支持一键替换为专业品牌风格。触发词：去掉AI味道、UI美化、专业化、统一配色、去除AI味、de-ai、品牌风格
